name: settleup-server
description: No-login shared expenses for short-lived private-by-link events

scripts.typecheck: npm run check:prepare && npm run check:types
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run check:tests
scripts.lint: npm run check:prepare && npm run check:lint
scripts.clean:server: node --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { force: true, recursive: true })"
scripts.clean: npm run clean:server && npm run clean --workspace @settleup/contracts && npm run clean --workspace @settleup/web
scripts.build:server: npm run build:contracts && npm run clean:server && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json
scripts.build:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @settleup/web
scripts.build:all: npm run build:contracts && npm run check:build
scripts.check:prepare: npm run build:contracts && npm run typegen --workspace @settleup/web
scripts.check:types: npm run typecheck:contracts && npm run typecheck:server && npm exec --workspace @settleup/web -- tsc --noEmit
scripts.check:lint: eslint src/server packages/contracts/src apps/web/app apps/web/tests apps/web/*.ts
scripts.check:tests: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:server && npm run test:web
scripts.check:build: npm run clean:server && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && npm run build --workspace @settleup/web
scripts.check:code: npm run check:design-doc && npm run check:prepare && npm run check:lint && npm run check:types && npm run check:tests && npm run check:build
